name: Pattern 11
html:
Solution Approach:

This problem is very similar to the star triangle pattern. Just in place of stars, now we have to print numbers in increasing order. The number of rows is equal to the input value "n" and each row has as many numbers in it, but maintaining the existing increasing sequence.
First let us revisit the star pattern formation program that we wrote earlier.

import java.util.*; public class Main{ public static void main(String[] args) { Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in); int n = scn.nextInt(); for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) { for(int j = 1; j <= i; j++) { System.out.print("* "); } System.out.println(); } } }
java; true";

This program used to give us the output as follows.

Now we just have to replace these stars with an increasing sequence starting from 1.

For that, we declare a variable called "val" for storing our printing values and initialize it to 1.
Then as the inner loop iterates, we increase value of "val" by 1 for each iteration as the inner loop will be responsible for the printing and updating variable "val".

The program for the same will be as follows:

import java.util.*; public class Main{ public static void main(String[] args) { Scanner scn = new Scanner(System.in); int n = scn.nextInt(); int val = 1; //initializing value variable for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) { for(int j = 1; j <= i; j++) { System.out.print( val +" "); // printing val + space val++; // incrementing val by 1 } System.out.println(); } } }
java; true";

This code will yield us our required output:

But let us analyze how this code is actually working.

At the start, we input value of n =5.We initialize i =1 inside the loop and val = 1 outside the outer loop.
Now since i<= n is the terminal condition for outer loop, it will run 5 times, and the inner loop with j =1 will run 5 times for each iteration of outer loop.
As we can see the status of stack with values being updated on every iteration of outer loop, we can see the val separated with values to be printed on each row (1 on row 1 ; 2,3 on row 2.. and so on).
